propositions: A one-time backfill script must sample historical commits (default monthly cadence) and measure cyclomatic complexity via lizard and code clones via jscpd.
The backfill must parse tool output into integer metrics (complexity = summed CCN, clone_count = total clones) and write snapshots with source=snapshot, confidence=high.
Snapshot timestamps must use the commit's author/committer date (git show -s --format=%cI), not wall-clock time, to preserve historical trend accuracy.
If a tool is absent or errors for a sampled commit, measure_tree returns None and that commit is skipped without aborting the backfill; other snapshots are still written and logged.
The test harness mocks measure_tree to stub tool output, ensuring the test tier is deterministic and requires no external tool installation.
